notes.title: Wholesome Steam Celebration Is Live
notes.content:
[h1]The Steam Celebration is Live![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/ca0c1cea73583cf4ba686420bb5faf50b6eef523.jpg"][/img][/p][p]📢 Yesterday Pawsta joined an incredible lineup of cozy games on Steam for this year's [b]Wholesome Games [/b]Celebration! 🥳 

We're honoured to be a part of this fantastic event & have already seen a surge in wishlists. We are now at over 7k wishlists, which is incredible! All the support is just so unbelievable & I'd love to extend a huge thank you to Wholesome Games and our new supporters for making a huge difference! You're the best!

We'd also like to encourage you all to check out all the new cozy releases & demos featured [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]on the event page[/url], plus wishlist the upcoming ones that catch your eye!
[/p][h1]New Dishwashing Screenshot[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/9e2ca901c3be08ffa4f8d6ae7d9571d1176ee5e1.png"][/img][/p][p]After a month working together, me (Harry) & Felicia also pushed to upload a new screenshot showcasing a dishwashing scene to give a preview of the new, completely 3D claymation style that we're pushing for!  🎨

It still needs some polish, and we want to add more Italian elements, but we feel we're getting somewhere with the lighting, effects & shape language ✨ 

We broke down the process on our Discord, if anyone wants to dive deeper into our behind-the-scenes, feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/fYwK2vUdah"]join us there[/url] for some mini updates: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/31dd3d1e180a9e4380e7f22f26245c3333df02e1.png"][/img][/p][h1]Steam Page Now Available in 15 Languages[/h1][p]We also took the celebration as an opportunity to localise our Steam page into as many languages as we could quickly tick off! Let us know if we're missing any big ones!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/ba8e1194b060b1e21330f17d22eb110fa008d3d4.png"][/img]
We drew upon Pawsta's international team & called in a ton of favours to achieve this! My huge gratitude extends to everyone who helped make this happen 🗺️🥰

It's been particularly fun seeing how each language translates "meep" into other cute mouse noises!

I'd also like to single out some of my indie dev friends who helped out with the translations:

- Edwige, creator of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411970/The_Abbess_Garden/"]The Abbess Garden[/url] (France) 🥰 
- Les, co-creator of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706280/Hedenite/"]Hedenite[/url] (Ukraine) 🥰

Please support them too! [/p][p][/p][h1]Thank you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/35aba1797e2b808cd98687f84e6f5cf832957f27.jpg"][/img][/h1][p]And that about covers the Pawsta news for today! 

I'll be heading off for a quick holiday back home to England, followed by a trip to Germany for Gamescom, so will check back later this month!

If you're at Gamescom, look out for a long-haired chap with a chef's outfit!

Till then,
[i]Pawsta la vista! -[/i] Harry[/p]

notes.title: Pawsta is joining the Wholesome Games Celebration 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]
Hey again, Pawsta-farians! 👋

Time to check in again!
[/h3][h1]Wholesome Games Celebration 🎉[/h1][p]
First up we have some exciting news that our friends at Wholesome Games will again be shining a light on Pawsta again next week! We're so grateful that they're being so supportive of us, it's really an amazing honour! The art is also so much fun:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/128951b0ad3cc2d267de476c1418b77425cc28d6.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are some official details about the event:

[i]The Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam will return August 7-14! Now in its third year, this event features world premiere game announcements, new releases, discounts, and demos.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Thank you all for the support! 🥰[/h1][p]August 7th will also mark exactly two months since Pawsta's Steam page debut! We have received so much support in this time, and it has been a huge source of motivation for the team!  

Currently. we're standing at [b]over 6,500 wishlists[/b] & we hope to gain more as we start translating the Steam page into more languages! Luckily, we're quite an international team & have plenty of indie friends in other countries so we're hoping to tick off a bunch! Here are some planned:  

Italian, Swedish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, French, Korean, German, Spanish (Latin America), Russian, Ukrainian, Polish & Japanese.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/99b34209e53e0cb80201375e971e2faf05fc4b7b.gif"][/img][/p][h1]Welcoming Felicia to the team! 🤗[/h1][p]Since the start of July, I've had Felicia on-site helping with 3D and 2D art! It's also super motivating to have her helping me out full-time! Here's a pic of us wearing our Wholesome Direct tees:

She's doing a super great job of adapting to the claymation art pipeline & we can't wait to share what we've been cooking up! A big focus atm is expanding the pasta area and making it more Italian-feeling. For example, here's a cute little olive tree Felicia made to fit the theme:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/db5d5add3b7e1b62458f69b0d7215d37cf1d0104.png"][/img][/p][h1]Stay up-to-date with socials 🐦[/h1][p]We've also started being a lot more active on TikTok and other socials lately. So that it doesn't impact development too much, we've taken the advice of other indies, and just do a [i]"marketing Monday"[/i] to come up with fun ideas, then spread them out across the week!  

The aim is to reach other audiences this way & keep upping the wishlists so we have a stronger case for securing full-project funding & publishing! We're still finding our feet here, and have one video that's gotten 8k views, but absolutely could do better! 

So we [i]really appreciate[/i] any comments, likes & retweets as they tell the algorithm that it's good content that should be spread around further!

I'm posting plenty of behind-the-scenes stuff, memes, sneak peeks & even slice-of-life content as I want to mix my personal stuff to show that developing games isn't just about chaining yourself to a pc!  As well as [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cozy_harry"]TikTok[/url], I'm posting this content to [url="https://www.instagram.com/cold.sector/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@cozy_harry/shorts"]YouTube Shorts[/url] & [url="https://www.facebook.com/pawstagame"]Facebook[/url]!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/91cff638484d6b79d2783472e2b3e2baa6e668ac.png"][/img][/p][h1]Share Tasty Food Pics!😋[/h1][p][url="https://discord.gg/fYwK2vUdah"]Our Discord[/url] is also getting more active, especially with food pics being shared!

It's no secret that Pawsta was inspired by the team's big love for cooking, so we're super happy to see that others are joining in with sharing recipes, meals & is super yummy pics! 

There's plenty of internationals on the server too, so it's fun seeing some super varied & exotic eats!

If that sounds, up your street feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/fYwK2vUdah"]join in on the fun[/url]! We'd love to see what you've been cooking up/ or stumbling across, too! 

E.g. here's a yummy Swedish-style strawberry cake Felicia made for my birthday a few weeks back:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/a289bd1cceb26003c650480cc29a192cd8108661.png"][/img][/p][h1]Some small updates 🗞️[/h1][p]For those who are extra curious, here are some things we've been working on, except for upping our social presence, processing our new fandom, & teambuilding![/p][list][*][p]Designing a bigger Italian kitchen with Pasta and Pizza areas 🍕[/p][/*][*][p]Making fun interacts like objects that wobble when you click them! 🫵[/p][/*][*][p]Converting the game from 2D logic to 3D logic 🧊[/p][/*][*][p]Prototyping cooking minigames!🕹️[/p][/*][*][p]Better cameras, transitions & lighting 🔦[/p][/*][*][p]Stepping up our sfx/ music game by using FMOD 🎶[/p][/*][*][p]Adding an outline shader to interacts 🔳[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of planning & pitch building, so we can reach out to investors & publishers✍️[/p][/*][/list][p]
Here's a look at some of the protototyping! One big thing I'm pushing for is adding more playfulness to Pawsta. This means things that aren't exactly essential, but hopefully make you smile:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/6e00afb6d9d12bc66a3fd9b5d1608d18c3367eb1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What's Next 👀[/h1][p]The next big thing on our calendar is a huge event... [b]Gamescom[/b]!  For those who don't know, Gamescom is a yearly convention in Germany (Cologne)! It's the biggest of it's kind in Europe! If you want to say hi & grab a sticker,  maybe reach out on social media!

I'll be wearing chef's clothes & probably loitering mostly around the Spielfabrique stand, as I was part of their European Videogame Accelerator lineup this year!  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/c91fa1e6e947fb46d624a23200bc00146032f87b.png"][/img]
And that about wraps things up for now!
 Until next time.. [/p][h2]Pawsta la vista! 🐭[/h2][p]- Harry[/p]

notes.title: Pawsta 🐭 has over 5000 Wishlists ✨
notes.content:
[h1]Woah!🐭💥[/h1][p]We got too excited & forgot to post here! [/p][p]But Pawsta reached [b]5000 wishlists[/b] on June 15th! [/p][p]And it [u]only[/u] took [b]9 days! 🤯
[/b]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/3df4c930dd5f25b59b5ad8ac8846cd36ca16cc74.png"][/img]Ahhhh![/p][p]I always set my expectations low, so this was such an amazing surprise!

The whole team is so blown away with how many people our goofy game about a mouse making food has resonated with! 🥰

Sincerely, thank you all so much! 💖[/p][p]  [/p][h1]Behind the Scenes[/h1][p]Let's dive into some behind-the-scenes stuff![/p][p]Recently, I was sharing how I plan game-making with some other cozy game devs & they thought my process was really clean & cool, so I thought I might as well share some sneak peaks in case it's useful or interesting to anyone here! ✨
[/p][h3]Planning set design, branching recipes & minigames 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/b3f1449ae4525714fd7b9b6f7426c0a1d3423f9e.png"][/img][/h3][p]I've used sites like Miro in the past, but I eventually discovered that Canva fits my workflow best for quickly making gameplay mock-ups & sharing  my vision with the team. The best part is it's also presentable and editable, so it's easy for us to collaborate further 🧩
[/p][h3]Claymation [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/41c12a3f9e84db1a965f1bec7edd583f01b19487.gif"][/img][/p][p]In Pawsta, all of the claymation is actually.. simulated! Instead of painstakingly moulding things by hand, we use a plug-in for Blender to create our assets & then flick through models & renders in Unity to simulate a stop-motion effect 🪄

We also use a shader so that 2D elements like menu icons get a wibbly-wobbly feeling too! 🪼
[/p][p]Also, the weird blue-boxed image in the top-left shows off the stupid-simple 3D magic behind our environments. Though we're gradually incorporating more hands-on 3D models in the game, sometimes we've been layering 2D renders and setting up hitboxes manually in the scene. It's quite fiddly though, so we might eventually drift away from this..🤔
[/p][h3]Sneak Peeks[/h3][p]Stay tuned, it hasn't been that long since the Steam launch yet 👀[/p][p]But we're getting back to cooking up more content now! 🧑‍🍳
[/p][h1]Be more involved![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/343cdb65ff50ffb6137b5c75aaab7de86fb51be7.png"][/img][/p][p]If you want to follow Pawsta or my game-dev life a bit closer there's a few ways to do it:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/fYwK2vUdah"]Discord[/url] - more frequent community engagements & share food pics/ recipes 💙[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cozy_harry"]Tiktok[/url] - silly Pawsta content, cooking & slice of life videos 🎵[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/pawstagame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] - our preferred microblogging social media site 🦋[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@cozy_harry"]YouTube[/url] - same as tiktok, but plan to post some longer-form devlog content too! 📺[/p][/*][/list][p]
The discord is especially starting to get more lively, and I would love it if we got more cooking and food pics being shared there! 🍝[/p][p][/p][h1]Signing off!
[/h1][p]It may be a little while until the next update, but we will try to do one per month where possible! So, again, feel free to check out the recommended socials above [i](and others below)[/i] to keep up-to-date in the meantime! ✨

The next big milestone will be 10k wishlists, but we expect things to slow down now that the wholesome direct buzz is over, so keep sharing if you want to help us reach this goal! 🤗

Thanks again for the tremendous support! [/p][p]Harry (Creative Director of Pawsta) 💖

And, until next time,[/p][h1]Pawsta la vista!🐭[/h1][p][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for the warm welcome!
notes.content:
[h1]Wow! What a warm welcome! 🥰[/h1][p]
We're so overwhelmed with the paw-sitive response that our lil' cooking game has gotten in our first week on Steam! Sincerely, thank you all so much for the love & support! It means so much! 🥹[/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlists are stacking up like grated cheese 🧀[/h2][p]
In just our first day, we received this many wishlists:[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/759dda88c19bef40ebef378259b88ff7b24dbfeb.gif"][/img]

2367! 😮[/h2][p]
Honestly, mind-blowing! 🤯
And it's looking like we will hit 5k any day now!  👀[/p][p][/p][h2]So many fun reactions!🐱[/h2][p]
Beacuse of the Wholesome Direct, we got so many streamers interacting with Pawsta too!

It's been so much fun watching all of them react to Pawsta! Everyone is so quick to want to say the name out loud & it's just so cute!  ahhh! 💖

[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cozy_harry/video/7515798536789757206"]Check out this video[/url] if you want a quick dose of cuteness :3[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/7508bb46ca5cc5fc01315c88de38daa76450ab69.png"][/img][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cozy_harry" style="button"]Watch on TikTok[/url][/p][p]Might make another sometime; we had so many amazing reactions!
[/p][h2]Check out Squeakross! 🐀[/h2][p][/p][p]I'd also like to quickly  promote another rodent game - Squeakross!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871440/Squeakross_Home_Squeak_Home/"][/dynamiclink]Squeakross is such a delightfully positive game & the devs have put so much love and care into making it! The mix of solving Picross puzzles to create furniture & outfits for your lil' rodent friend is genius!

I'm also friends with the 2 developers, and they're such amazing people, who deserve all the support in the world! 🙌

Oh! And the rodent editor is seriously good! I even managed to make something that pretty closely resembles a 3D Rigatoni ahah! 🐭

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/f4bb77f160c7fa846f566aa6ef07862509700dcf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's Next! 🤗
[/h2][p]Now that Pawsta has been properly promoted and announced via the Wholesome Direct, we're finding our feet with sharing Pawsta content to social medias, to keep the community growing & get more eyes on our game! 👀

Being able to point to wishlists & engagement also helps a lot with convincing publishers & investors to back our game & speed up production, so it's high on priorities right now.

If you want to support & engage further feel free to check out those social buttons at the bottom of this post! I'm (Harry) personally most active on Discord, Bluesky & Tiktok though! ✨

Of course, we're also diving back into production now, so will share updates whenever we can! There's so much we want to update & add to the game now! 

It's also looking like we will be taking on a new artist, which will be a huge boost! 🎨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/bf103af17932fd576359930dc79b31fd81eebd1f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Kickstarter hype! 💚
[/h2][p]We also got a lot of new attention towards our Kickstarter, which is amazing! But we still need a lot more followers before we can go live with the campaign, so please consider pressing the big button [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coldsector/pawsta-a-cozy-claymation-cooking-game"]on the campaign here[/url]:

[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coldsector/pawsta-a-cozy-claymation-cooking-game" style="button" buttoncolor="#1b5502"]Pawsta's Kickstarter[/url][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/5eefc851d8b131156bb3fabf0ed4695cdca75482.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Thank you again! Pawsta la vista! 👋[/h1][p]Again, thank you all so much for the support! It means the world to us! 💖

Will report back when we hit 5k! Then will try to at least do monthly posts while we carry on with development 🤗[/p]

notes.title: Pawsta featured on Wholesome Direct 25!
notes.content:
[h1]Eeee Pawsta was on Wholesome Direct 25![/h1][p] Today we launched our Steam page along with our feature on this year's Wholesome Direct, which we couldn't be prouder to be a part of! 

Pawsta actually started as a [url="https://monstrouscatgirl.itch.io/pawsta-the-game"]Wholesome Game Jam project[/url] and the original team met on the community discord, so it was incredibly meaningful to be featured! eeee we have been so excited![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/52cac84c4b3bb34623242bce17536aca1606da99.png"][/img]Not only that, but our lil' mouse, Rigatoni, is part of [url="https://store.serenityforge.com/products/wholesome-direct-2025-campfire-characters-unisex-t-shirt"]the official tee[/url], with all sales proceeds going to a fantastic charity! It's so heartwarming to see him there toasting a lil marshmallow!

Maybe consider supporting! We're definitely going to buy a few! [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/dbdf070a850a650041eede6717b327beb9a7b0e1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/fd094c8b297bff811f25d5447266fe4c27163a4b.png"][/img][/carousel][p]
Another cool thing is [url="https://patchmagazine.co.uk/"]Patch magazine[/url] is covering the Direct! We've long been fans of this cute monthy mag, and it's amazing to have something like this in 2025. Last year they had a big tick list of all the games, so it's likely Pawsta will show up in something similar!

Check out [url="https://bsky.app/profile/coldsector.se/post/3lr2262a4222d"]their post here[/url], to see how to get a copy!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650293/9d898be34e45b285903e6cdde0433ad819894b43.jpg"][/img]
So finally, you can check out Pawstaaa and all the other cozy games featured in the direct here, we're near the very end as part of the closing montage![/p][previewyoutube="D4ZRXGcmDlM;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Till next time! [i]Pawsta la vista![/i] 
  [/h3]
